sections.title: Resolution
sections.text: Confirmed by the executor: after the move write_skill_manifest looks up now_iso in aicore.delivery.materialize, so the skiller.common.now_iso patch in test_provider_publication_parity never ran. The patch now targets aicore.delivery.materialize.now_iso; the first sync asserts the clock was called, the unchanged second sync asserts it was not (installed_at kept). No product code changed.
